# opencollective_collective (Resource)

Manages an Open Collective collective. Requires a `personal_token` with the `account` scope.

Changing `host_slug` removes the current host (pausing, not cancelling, recurring contributions) and/or applies to the new host; the new host must still approve the application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opencollective_collective" "example" {
  name             = "My Project"
  slug             = "my-project"
  description      = "Sustaining my open source project"
  long_description = "<p>A longer story about the project.</p>"
  tags             = ["open source", "go"]
  currency         = "USD"

  # Apply to a fiscal host. The host must approve the application;
  # see host_application_status.
  host_slug = "opensource"

  social_links = [
    { type = "WEBSITE", url = "https://example.com" },
    { type = "GITHUB", url = "https://github.com/example/my-project" },
  ]

  # Collectives with financial activity cannot be deleted; archive instead.
  archive_on_destroy = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Short description of the collective.
- `name` (String) Public name of the collective.
- `slug` (String) Slug of the collective, used in its URL (`https://opencollective.com/<slug>`).

### Optional

- `archive_on_destroy` (Boolean) Archive the collective on destroy instead of deleting it. Collectives with financial activity cannot be deleted, so set this for those. Defaults to `false`.
- `currency` (String) Currency code of the collective, e.g. `USD`. Defaults to the host's currency when not set.
- `host_slug` (String) Slug of the fiscal host to apply to, e.g. `opensource`. A pending application counts as the host; see `host_application_status`.
- `long_description` (String) Long description of the collective (HTML).
- `social_links` (Attributes List) Links to the collective's profiles on other platforms, in order of preference. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--social_links))
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the collective.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `host_application_status` (String) Status of the most recent host application: `PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED` or `EXPIRED`.
- `id` (String) Public identifier of the collective.
- `image_url` (String) URL of the collective's logo.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the collective is active (has an approved host and can receive contributions).
- `is_approved` (Boolean) Whether the collective has been approved by its host.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the collective is archived.
- `legacy_id` (Number) Legacy numeric identifier of the collective.
- `type` (String) Account type, always `COLLECTIVE`.
- `website` (String) Website of the collective, derived from its social links.

<a id="nestedatt--social_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `social_links`

Required:

- `type` (String) Platform type, e.g. `GITHUB` or `WEBSITE`.
- `url` (String) URL of the profile.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A collective can be imported by its public ID or its slug.
tofu import opencollective_collective.example dgm9bnk8-0437xqry-ejpvzeol-jdayw5re
tofu import opencollective_collective.example my-project
```
